rocq_source.description: PaperCore Rocq formalization used as the source of truth for the mathematical POPL presentation.

public_results.name: local_obligations_sound
public_results.role: Paper-level soundness theorem: a local invariant certificate implies automata-level contract validity.

public_results.name: generated_obligations_sound
public_results.role: Generated-obligation bridge: exact generated obligations imply automata-level contract validity through the local certificate theorem.

public_results.name: concrete_environment_generated_obligations_sound
public_results.role: Concrete imperative/environment-assumption adequacy theorem used by the paper.

paper_formalization_source.principle: The POPL mathematical presentation should follow the Rocq concepts, names, and theorem cuts first; Kairos implementation names are secondary.
paper_formalization_source.main_theorem_shape: GeneratedObligationsValid -> contract_valid, plus semantic-witness completeness for product-local certificates
paper_sections_suggested_by_rocq: contract automata and global assume-guarantee validity

alignment_units.name: source_language_and_wf
alignment_units.proof_role: Defines the program object quantified by the main theorem and the static assumptions required before obligation generation.
alignment_units.architecture_status: core_model essential; frontend elaboration is outside the current proof boundary
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: the normalized core program consumed by verification
state count, initial state, transitions, guards, bodies, inputs, outputs, locals
well-formedness checks that are assumed by Rocq or delegated to a later elaboration theorem

alignment_units.name: instrumented_run_and_observations
alignment_units.proof_role: Gives the execution semantics and observation trace used by contracts and temporal formulas.
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: current tick, previous tick, and pre_k slots
which generated facts are previous-tick, step-context, or current-tick facts
temporal lowering from source formulas to explicit history slots

alignment_units.name: historical_initialization_frontier
alignment_units.proof_role: States the source-point availability contract for historical formulas: every formula accepted at a point must have required depth bounded by the point age.
alignment_units.architecture_status: source well-formedness frontier; Rocq formalizes the contract, while min_ticks_by_state is the current OCaml implementation witness rather than a certified algorithm
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: required depth of each historical source formula
age available at each source point where the formula is checked
the validator rejection point for required_depth > age
the separation between historical availability and current-input admissibility

alignment_units.name: contract_automata
alignment_units.proof_role: Supplied assumption and guarantee automata are parameters of the proof; Spot translation is outside the theorem, while the implementation validates the product-level normal form before exploration.
alignment_units.architecture_status: supplied automata are essential inputs; automata generation is an external boundary; product normal-form validation is a reference-product boundary check
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: assumption automaton states, initial state, bad state, and transitions
guarantee automaton states, initial state, bad state, and transitions
the point where generated automata become supplied reference inputs
the point where Product_build validates the automata normal form consumed by product exploration

alignment_units.name: product_anchors_and_classification
alignment_units.proof_role: Defines product states, product steps, and the safe/bad-assumption/bad-guarantee classification used by progression and contradiction.
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: ProductStateAnchor: program state, assume state, guarantee state
ProductStepAnchor: source, destination, selected program transition
StepSafe, StepBadAssumption, StepBadGuarantee classification
default transitions and real indexed transitions
the policy for stopping or continuing after bad automaton states

alignment_units.name: product_summary_generation
alignment_units.proof_role: Produces proof-step summaries, clause families, requirements, safe cases, unsafe cases, and ensures from source program plus supplied automata.
alignment_units.architecture_status: Pre/Post/Temporal_lower are essential; Product_summary_projection, Kernel_clause_projection and Obligation_family_projection are neutral alignment views; proof_export summaries and clauses are projection witnesses that must consume them if used
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: ProofStepSummaryIdentity: program transition id, product source, assume guard
propagation_requires, requires, runtime_requires, ensures
safe cases and unsafe cases
entry clauses and non-entry clause families
safe summary grouping and its coverage/preservation argument

alignment_units.name: step_contract_extraction
alignment_units.proof_role: Relates product summaries to lowered step contracts used for generated obligation validity.
alignment_units.architecture_status: Step_contract_projection is the neutral alignment view; Why3 scheduling and encoding choices are backend
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: safe step contract generation from summaries
bad-guarantee step contract generation from unsafe cases
lowering of requires, ensures, and forbidden formulas
deduplication that preserves members
the boundary before backend grouping, helper naming, or solver calls

alignment_units.name: generated_obligation_validity
alignment_units.proof_role: Collects exactly the semantic assumptions discharged by external provers before applying the main soundness theorem.
alignment_units.architecture_status: external proof discharge is backend; the set and meaning of obligations must be determined before backend execution
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: safe obligation validity
unsafe obligation validity
initial invariant goal validity
the exact canonical obligation set before Why3 grouping and scheduling

alignment_units.name: soundness_assembly
alignment_units.proof_role: Assembles propagation, contradiction of bad guarantee steps, and global automata validity.
alignment_units.architecture_status: the implementation must expose the canonical objects consumed by this argument; it must not hide them behind backend artifacts
must_be_identifiable_in_kairos: where propagation hypotheses come from
where bad-guarantee exclusions are generated
where assumption-never-bad remains an assumption
where the proof result plugs into the global assume-guarantee theorem

not_part_of_rocq_core.name: spot_translation
not_part_of_rocq_core.reason: Rocq theorem is relative to supplied automata.

not_part_of_rocq_core.name: why3_backend_planning
not_part_of_rocq_core.reason: Why3 encoding, helper grouping, worker scheduling, and solver statuses discharge obligations but do not define them.

not_part_of_rocq_core.name: diagnostics_and_dumps
not_part_of_rocq_core.reason: These are presentation and inspection artifacts.
